## 2. Engineering Services & Architecture

### A. Mobile-First Web Design & UI/UX Prototyping
- Bespoke user experience research and interactive Figma wireframes before any code is written.
- Tailored design systems reflecting client brand identity, eliminating generic templates.
- Mobile-first optimization designed specifically for Kenyan internet infrastructure (Safaricom 4G/5G, Airtel Kenya), ensuring sub-1.5 second page load speeds.
- Clean semantic HTML5, modern vanilla CSS / Tailwind CSS, and vanilla JavaScript architectures without unnecessary framework bloat.

### B. E-Commerce & Daraja M-Pesa API Engineering
- Native integration with Safaricom Daraja 2.0 API, including instant M-Pesa STK Push prompts, C2B paybill/till validation, and instant SMS/email payment notifications.
- International card processing integration (Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, Pesapal, Flutterwave).
- Product catalog management, category filtering, inventory tracking, stock alerts, discount coupon engines, and automated PDF tax invoice generation.

### C. Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) & Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO)
- Modern multi-layered search architecture ensuring visibility in traditional search engines (Google, Bing) and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini).
- Complete structured data implementation using JSON-LD schema (Organization, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, Service, Product, Article, BreadcrumbList).
- Local search optimization for competitive commercial search queries in Nairobi, Westlands, Kilimani, Upper Hill, Kiambu, and nationwide.
- Core Web Vitals optimization targeting 95+ Google PageSpeed Insights performance scores.

### D. Custom Web Applications, Enterprise Portals & SaaS
- Full-stack web application development for custom business workflows, quotation calculators, booking and reservation engines, and membership platforms.
- Secure relational database design (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and modern REST / GraphQL APIs.
- Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) supporting multi-tier admin, staff, vendor, and client permissions.

### E. Frostwood CRM
- Proprietary customer relationship management and sales lead pipeline software developed by Xclusive Tech.
- Built specifically for Kenyan service businesses to track lead acquisition from social media ads, organize WhatsApp inquiries, automate follow-ups, and measure conversion velocity.

### F. Domain Registration, Cloud DNS & Web Hosting
- Transparent registration of top-level domains (.co.ke, .com, .org, .ke, .africa, .io) starting at KES 1,500/year, paid directly via M-Pesa.
- High-speed NVMe SSD cloud hosting setup, custom business email configuration (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, cPanel), automated SSL certificates, and DNS security.
- Transparent billing where domain and hosting credentials belong 100% to the client.

### G. Social Media Management & Digital Marketing Retainers
- Comprehensive social media architecture covering TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
- High-converting content strategy, video reels, graphic design, ad campaign setup, and monthly performance reporting.

## 3. Transparent Published Pricing Structure (KES)

All prices are published openly on https://www.xclusivetech.co.ke/pricing with zero hidden charges. Standard payment terms are a 50% milestone deposit upon contract execution and 50% upon final client sign-off and production deployment.

### 1. Express Sales Landing Page — KES 15,000
- **Best For**: Paid advertising funnels (TikTok, Meta Ads, Google Ads), solo practitioners, consultants, event promotions, and service pros needing fast customer acquisition.
- **Delivery Timeline**: 3 to 5 business days.
- **Scope**: 1 high-converting long-form page featuring 5 conversion sections (Hero Hook, Core Offer & Deliverables, Social Proof & Reviews, FAQ Accordion, Final Call to Action).
- **Inclusions**: 1-click WhatsApp inquiry widget, direct lead intake form with anti-spam protection, sub-1.5s mobile speed, OpenGraph WhatsApp preview card, Google Maps link, and custom domain SSL connection.
- **Risk Reversal Guarantee**: 100% Upgrade Credit Guarantee — if the client upgrades to a multi-page website within 6 months, the entire KES 15,000 is credited toward the new package.

### 2. Starter Site Package — KES 25,000 to KES 45,500
- **Best For**: Startups, law firms, consultants, clinics, and professional firms requiring an authoritative digital profile.
- **Delivery Timeline**: 2 to 3 weeks.
- **Scope**: Up to 5 custom-designed pages (e.g., Home, About Us, Services, Portfolio / Case Studies, Contact Us).
- **Inclusions**: Bespoke Figma UI/UX prototyping, 100% responsive mobile layout, foundational on-page SEO (meta tags, sitemaps, H1-H3 hierarchy), WhatsApp integration, contact form, and 30 days post-launch warranty.

### 3. Business Growth Package — KES 49,000 to KES 62,000
- **Best For**: Expanding mid-sized enterprises, commercial service providers, and multi-service organizations requiring rich content and active lead generation.
- **Delivery Timeline**: 3 to 5 weeks.
- **Scope**: Up to 15 custom pages + dynamic CMS blog module for regular publishing.
- **Inclusions**: Advanced SEO & schema markup, Google Analytics 4 & Google Search Console integration, lead capture popups/magnets, speed optimization, and 60 days priority technical support.

### 4. E-Commerce Pro Package — KES 72,000 to KES 85,000
- **Best For**: Online retailers, fashion boutiques, electronics stores, supermarkets, and wholesale distributors.
- **Delivery Timeline**: 5 to 7 weeks.
- **Scope**: Unlimited product catalog with categories, search, filtering, customer user accounts, and cart/checkout workflows.
- **Inclusions**: Automated Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa STK Push payment gateway, automated PDF receipts, WhatsApp order notification alerts, inventory stock management, coupon engine, and staff training.

### 5. Custom Enterprise Solutions — From KES 85,000+
- **Best For**: Bespoke SaaS applications, multi-vendor marketplaces, booking platforms, custom API architectures, and enterprise portal workflows.
- **Delivery Timeline**: Scoped per technical specification sprint.
- **Scope**: Custom system architecture, database modeling, dedicated lead developer, and service level agreements (SLA).

### 6. Website Maintenance & Ongoing Care Plans
- Monthly maintenance retainers starting from KES 2,000/month covering weekly cloud backups, core software security patches, uptime monitoring, minor content updates, and priority developer support.

### 7. Social Media Management Retainer Packages
- **Starter Package**: KES 12,000/month — 12 static posts/month, 4 reels/stories, hashtag research, community monitoring.
- **Business Package**: KES 18,000/month — 20 posts/month, 8 reels/stories, sponsored ads setup, monthly growth analytics report.

- **Coast Region**: Mombasa (Nyali, Bamburi, Changamwe), Kwale (Diani Beach), Kilifi (Malindi, Watamu, Mtwapa), Lamu (LAPSSET, Shela), Taita-Taveta (Voi), Tana River (Hola).
- **Central Region**: Kiambu (Thika, Ruiru, Juja, Kikuyu, Limuru), Nyeri (Karatina), Murang'a (Kenol), Kirinyaga (Mwea, Sagana), Nyandarua (Ol Kalou).
- **Rift Valley Region**: Nakuru (Nakuru City, Naivasha), Uasin Gishu (Eldoret City), Kajiado (Kitengela, Rongai, Ngong), Kericho (Tea estates), Bomet (Sotik), Laikipia (Nanyuki, Nyahururu), Narok (Maasai Mara), Trans Nzoia (Kitale), Baringo (Kabarnet), Nandi (Kapsabet), Elgeyo-Marakwet (Iten), Samburu (Maralal), Turkana (Lodwar, Kakuma), West Pokot (Kapenguria).
- **Western Region**: Kakamega (Kakamega Town, Mumias), Bungoma (Webuye, Chwele), Busia (Malaba, Busia OSBP), Vihiga (Luanda, Mbale).
- **Nyanza Region**: Kisumu (Kisumu City, Milimani), Kisii (Kisii Town, Tabaka), Homa Bay (Rusinga Island), Migori (Isebania border), Siaya (Bondo, Usenge), Nyamira (Borabu).
- **Eastern Region**: Machakos (Athi River, Syokimau, Mavoko), Meru (Timau, Maua), Embu (Runyenjes), Kitui (Mwingi), Makueni (Wote, Mtito Andei), Tharaka-Nithi (Chuka), Isiolo, Marsabit (Moyale).
- **North Eastern Region**: Garissa, Wajir, Mandera.

Every county page provides localized economic context, key commercial towns, transparent KES pricing, official M-Pesa integration, and direct WhatsApp project intake.
